meaning:
1) to feel
1a) (Qal) to feel
1b) (Hiphil) to feel

elsewhere.note: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”
They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
